newsitem.title: UK: UK MEALS START WEEK LOWER, IN WATCH AND WAIT MODE.
newsitem.headline: UK MEALS START WEEK LOWER, IN WATCH AND WAIT MODE.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were mostly lower on Monday with little activity reported.
Most players were focuses on the U.S. Midwest weather pattern and the USDA crop report due out on Tuesday.
"I don't think much will happen for the first couple of days while the market is in watch and wait mode, but things may started happening during the second part of the week, said one broker.
High protein soymeal started the week as much as four stg down ex-mill Liverpool, with store down a similar amount.
Rapemeal ex-mill Erith was unchanged while material from the Hull and Liverpool mills was one to two stg lower.
